task: masked middle radical (R2) recovery from (R1,R3), held-out K-fold
model_desc: Katz-style backoff: P(R2|R1,R3) → P(R2|R1)+P(R2|R3) → marginal P(R2)
interpretation: Structural only: tests whether the middle radical is recoverable from the outer radicals beyond base rates. The strong root structure is CATEGORICAL (see OCP), not combinatorially predictive — consistent with the decision that letters are non-semantic and meaning begins at roots.
